verdict.rationale: SigNoz's background-running pieces are alert rules on log patterns, counts, or attribute values, plus ingest-time log pipelines that parse and enrich data automatically. Service accounts grant programmatic API access for CI/CD pipelines and automation scripts. Its AI features (MCP server, Agent Skills) are interactive tools used by external assistants, not autonomous background jobs, so any autonomous agentic automation must be built outside SigNoz. Missing for 10: native scheduled or triggered agentic workflows, autonomous AI remediation or investigation runs, an automation/workflow builder, and hands-on corroboration of background automation.
